info.name: Amrutam Telemedicine Platform API
info.description:
# Amrutam Telemedicine Platform — Complete API Collection

Production-grade Postman collection for the Amrutam Telemedicine backend.

### Features
- **Pre-configured Auth**: Bearer token authentication configured at the collection level.
- **Automated Token Capture**: Login and Register requests auto-save `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, and `userId` directly into Collection variables.
- **Automatic UUID Generation**: All mutation endpoints requiring `Idempotency-Key` dynamically inject `{{$guid}}`.
- **All Modules Included**: Auth, Users, Doctors, Availability, Bookings, Payments, Consultations, Prescriptions, Audit, Analytics, Metrics, and Health.

### Default Seed Credentials (Localhost)
- **Patient**: `patient@amrutam.global` / `PatientPassword123!`
- **Doctor**: `dr.ayurveda@amrutam.global` / `DoctorPassword123!`
- **Admin**: `admin@amrutam.global` / `AdminPassword123!`
- **Auditor**: `auditor@amrutam.global` / `AuditorPassword123!`
